goal: Speed up block index work comparisons during chainstate evaluation and best-chain candidate selection
Reduce branch overhead by allowing compilers to inline chainwork comparison logic
agreement: Strong support with no open objections across four reviewers
Support for a worthwhile hot-path micro-optimization using modern comparison operators (laanwj, optout21)
Readability concerns and testing gaps were resolved with reordered commits and fuzz tests (mzumsande, sipa)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it speeds up a hot path in block index sorting and chainstate evaluation
Comparator throughput increases 6.5x to 6.8x and block index validation rate improves 1.4x to 1.6x
